news.title: Premier Energy and Infrastructure Limited Appoints Ms. C Parvathi Nagaraj as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 7, 2026
news.body: Premier Energy and Infrastructure Limited has approved the appointment of Ms. C Parvathi Nagaraj as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) of the Company with effect from January 7, 2026. Ms. C Parvathi Nagaraj is an Associate Member of Institute of Company Secretaries of India and Institute of Cost Accountants of India. She has around 30 years of experience in the field of Corporate Law Compliance, Taxation and Finance. Ms. C Parvathi Nagaraj is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Company. The Board of Directors meeting was held on January 7, 2026.
